prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1043; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had already slowed almost to a stop and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came from the driver's side. The force jerked my vehicle sideways and my head snapped forward and back. Since the collision, I have been experiencing stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, and I have been having trouble sitting for long periods. I stopped at the scene, exchanged information with the other driver, and called the police to file a report. My car sustained visible damage to the front driver's side panel and the door. I am submitting this statement to document the accident and my injuries and to request coverage for my medical treatment and vehicle repairs.
